# Hash-pinned tool requirements for the CI spell-check job (Issue #1913).
#
# Installed by `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with:
#   pip install --user --require-hashes -r .github/requirements/codespell-requirements.txt
#
# `--require-hashes` makes the install reproducible and tamper-evident: pip
# refuses any artefact whose SHA-256 does not match, and refuses the whole
# install if any requirement is unpinned. codespell has no mandatory runtime
# dependencies (chardet and tomli are optional extras we do not install), so
# this single entry pins the complete tree.
#
# Both hashes below are for codespell 2.4.3 — the wheel and the sdist — so the
# pin holds whichever artefact pip selects.
#
# Renovate keeps this file current via the `pip_requirements` manager
# configured in `renovate.json`, under the same 24h quarantine window as every
# other external dependency.
codespell==2.4.3 \
    --hash=sha256:af2505b335e8573dbd2d384d1c4ef498f4006f4ba2d6fceca01e55b91f52628a \
    --hash=sha256:cbe085e331227b37bb86ef8bddd08dc768c704ee9a07ca869852c093fa2793e2
